title: US defends Trump's Venezuela oil deal
subhed: Trump met oil executives at the White House on Tuesday as he tries to tame gas prices that are spiraling because of the Iran war, with his administration hoping the Venezuela deal could help. Cheaper oil is a priority for the Trump administration ahead of crucial US midterm elections in November.

title: The dangers of 'eating jet lag': Why eating at irregular hours is bad for your health
subhed: A large-scale French study suggests that men who eat meals at highly variable times between workdays and days off face an increased risk of cardiovascular disease.

title: Will this summer's climate disasters push French politicians and citizens to act?
subhed: Heatwaves, wildfires and droughts, all intensified by climate change, do not lead to shifts in public attitudes without strong political will. Still, a sense of a need for protection and concrete measures is emerging.
